title: Demolition: remove drift, template, and waiver subsystems
description:
Per the sutra/176 decision (arc sutra/~12): delete the drift, template, and waiver subsystems. Lifetime usage: 0 waivers ever created across 48 workspaces, 0 templates in current DBs, no drift alert ever acted on.

Remove:
- `src/conventions/drift.rs` (entropy snapshots, DriftAlert) and `record_and_detect_drift` call in build_findings; `drift_alerts` field in ReviewFindings and compute() output
- `src/conventions/templates.rs` (decompose_signature, select_exemplars, generate_template) and `generate_templates_for_conventions` call in build_findings. Exemplar *selection* logic may be worth salvaging for the deviation report (exemplar pointers beat metavariable skeletons for an LLM consumer) — if so, move the ranking helper, delete the template generation.
- Tables + Db methods: `convention_snapshots`, `convention_templates` (both Ephemeral), `convention_waivers` (Durable — explicit DROP migration)
- Waiver partition in review (`waived_violations` in ReviewFindings), waiver CRUD actions on `sutra_conventions`
- Orient surfacing of templates, waivers, drift, and pending proposals in `src/tools/orient.rs`

Check before removing: whether drift feeds a health biomarker (docs/health-map.md) — if so, remove the biomarker reference too, don't leave a dangling tier.

Update `docs/conventions-map.md` (drift + templates sections, data-flow diagram, table list) and `docs/health-map.md` if touched.

Acceptance: cargo test passes; review output contains no drift_alerts/waived_violations fields; orient contains no template/waiver/proposal sections; maps updated.
execution_record: Scope expanded beyond the task description: health::drift module (compute_fca_conformance, compute_hrr_coherence, detect_convention_drift) also depended on convention_snapshots table, so it was removed along with the ConventionDrift biomarker variant from health/findings.rs and health/scoring.rs. Total: -2881 lines across 21 files, 3 modules deleted entirely (conventions/drift.rs, conventions/templates.rs, health/drift.rs), 4 tables dropped via migration 0045.

messages.text:
Codex adversarial review (covers sutra/231 + sutra/232 together, diff 6ce098e..af9c6f0):

Verdict: needs-attention (3 findings)

1. [high] Reindex resurrects dropped tables — ephemeral CREATE migrations (0016, 0020, 0022, 0034, 0036) rerun after reindex wipes their schema_migrations entries, but durable DROP migrations (0044, 0045) are skipped. Tables get recreated.
2. [high] cargo test gate not met — test_field_access_skipped in resolver_test.rs fails deterministically, but is pre-existing (not caused by this diff).
3. [medium] Stale MCP help text — src/tools/help.rs:319-320 still advertises "signature templates, anti-pattern warnings, drift alerts, waivers, and pending proposals" for orient, which were removed.

Finding 1 is the only ship-blocking issue from the demolition itself.
